title: Lugg Courier: an on-demand courier for small items
summary: Lugg Courier gives the small stuff its own way across town, on demand or scheduled ahead, with live tracking from pickup to delivery.
body_markdown:
Not every item needs movers and a truck. Sometimes it’s a lamp waiting at the store, a piece of art from a Facebook Marketplace seller, or a box of clothing donations that's been sitting in your trunk for weeks. None of those should cost you an afternoon sitting in traffic.


Now you can skip the trips. Lugg Courier is Lugg’s on-demand option for small-item delivery: items under 50 pounds that fit in a car and can be carried and handed off by one person.


Now available in the Lugg app for[iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lugg-moving-delivery/id919765207) and[Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lugg) , and[on the web](https://app.lugg.com/) . Made for the small stuff you’d rather not drive across town for.


## The small trips Courier is made for


Courier is the newest—and smallest—option in the Lugg lineup, especially useful for the small, slightly awkward things that need a ride across town but definitely don’t need a moving truck:


- the laptop you left at home but need at the office
- an espresso machine coming home from a seller or repair shop
- a vase, mirror, framed piece, or other[decor find from Marketplace, an auction, or an estate sale](https://lugg.com/used-item-delivery)
- [a paid order packed up and waiting behind the counter](https://lugg.com/store-delivery)
- a box of samples, supplies, or signage heading across town
- the return, package, or envelope you keep meaning to send


The simplest test is the handoff: the item should be ready to go, under 50 pounds and able to fit in the trunk or back seat of a car, and one person should be able to carry it comfortably. It's not for a piece that needs a moving crew, special equipment or a truck.


## How booking a Courier works


Booking a Courier works the same way as booking any other Lugg. Enter the pickup and drop-off addresses,[add up to five stops along the way](https://lugg.com/blog/introducing-multiple-stops-add-extra-pickups-drop-offs-in-one-lugg) , then choose your vehicle.


On the vehicle-selection screen, choose Courier, describe what’s making the trip, and decide whether you want it picked up on demand or scheduled for later. You’ll see an upfront estimate before you book.


Once your courier is on the way, follow their live location and ETA in the app through the final handoff.


## Where Courier fits in the Lugg lineup


Courier is for small, handoff-ready items under 50 pounds that fit in the trunk or back seat of a car. Lugg Lite is for items that need moving help: a pickup truck, moving blankets, or someone to lift, load, and carry the item at either end. Lite includes one Lugger and can handle items up to 125 pounds; for anything heavier,[see how Lugg’s per-item weight limits work](https://lugg.com/help/general/does-lugg-have-weight-limits) .


The simplest distinction: if the job only needs the ride, choose Courier. If it needs the lift, choose Lite.


## What you’ll see before you book


Courier starts at a $17 base fare, with mileage and labor time factored into your estimate. Enter your addresses, then tap **See pricing details** to view the full breakdown and what most customers pay for a Courier delivery like yours.


## The small stuff has a Lugg now


Some of the smallest deliveries create the most disproportionate errands: 45 minutes across town for a handoff that takes 30 seconds. Courier gives those jobs their own place in Lugg, without asking you to book moving help you don’t need.


Download the Lugg app for[iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lugg-moving-delivery/id919765207) or[Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lugg) , or book Courier[on the web](https://app.lugg.com/) .
